definitions.explanation: The overall feeling or character of a place, situation, or person.

examples.japanese: このレストランは{雰囲気|ふんいき}がいい。
examples.english: This restaurant has a nice atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}が{重|おも}かった。
examples.english: The atmosphere of the meeting was heavy.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}には{独特|どくとく}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}がある。
examples.english: She has a unique aura about her.

notes:
USAGE: {雰囲気|ふんいき} describes the intangible feeling of places, events, or people. Very commonly used in everyday conversation.

PRONUNCIATION NOTE: Though written ふんいき, some speakers say ふいんき. The standard pronunciation is ふんいき.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{雰囲気|ふんいき}がいい/わるい (good/bad atmosphere)
・{雰囲気|ふんいき}を{出|だ}す (to create atmosphere)
・{雰囲気|ふんいき}を{壊|こわ}す (to ruin the atmosphere)
・{雰囲気|ふんいき}に{飲|の}まれる (to be overwhelmed by the atmosphere)
・{独特|どくとく}の{雰囲気|ふんいき} (unique atmosphere)
